description: On 2023-11-14, a production deploy with a single approval caused a database migration to run incorrectly, resulting in 4 hours of payments downtime. Root cause: a missing null check in the migration script that was caught in code review by the second approver in staging but never in prod because staging has less data volume. Resolution: mandatory 2-approval policy for all production deploys, effective 2024-01-10. Owner of new policy: Priya Nair.
